A farm field layout diagram showing an experimental design (Randomized Complete Block Design). The field is divided into three blocks (columns) to account for a "Soil fertility gradient" (indicated by a large arrow pointing right, meaning fertility increases to the right). Inside each of the three blocks, square plots are randomly assigned three treatments: "Treatment 1 (T1)", "Treatment 2 (T2)", and a "Control (C)". The random arrangement shows T1, C, T2 in Block 1; C, T2, T1 in Block 2; and T2, T1, C in Block 3.
